content.title: How to watch Mets vs. Dodgers: TV channel and streaming options for April 15
content.text: The New York Mets will attempt to stop a seven-game losing streak when visiting the Los Angeles Dodgers at 10:10 p.m. ET on Wednesday. Shohei Ohtani (1-0, 0.00 ERA) gets the start for the Dodgers, who are 13-4 this season and first in the NL West.
